title: Senior Engineer, Infrastructure Management Services
bullets: Analyzed resolution-time data to address a 10% increase in customer complaints; client interaction and process changes reduced average resolution time by 8% over three months.

Developed a standardized process that reduced repeated-issue volume by 85%; also resolved server/workstation update, configuration, performance, patch, and backup issues while maintaining an almost 1–2% escalation rate.

title: Associate Professional Technical Support

title: Technical Support Specialist

title: Product Support Specialist
